ai/npc/DragonVortex/32871-01.html.text: Dragon Vortex: You do not possess a Large Dragon Bone and cannot summon a dragon to fight.

ai/npc/DragonVortex/32871-02.html.text: Dragon Vortex: You can't summon the monster this soon. Please wait a little.

ai/npc/DragonVortex/32871.html.text: Dragon Vortex: A mysterious vortex which has the power to summon one of Antharas' high commanding dragons. To call forth one of these creatures, you must use a Large Dragon Bone . Dragons to be summoned: Emerald Horn Dust Rider Bleeding Fly Blackdagger Wing Shadow Summoner Spike Slasher Muscle Bomb…
